subject: Staged evaluation: access commitments & connectivity compact
body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novagen.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged evaluation: access commitments & connectivity compact

Alex — thanks again for taking the time earlier. Per our MAP conversation, I want to align on a compact set of access and networking commitments so your team can start test runs next week without blockers. Below is a proposed micro-plan (3 workstreams) with owners and target dates. Please flag anything that won't work.

Workstream A — Org & API access (owner: Novagen / Alex)
- Novagen creates a Novagen-POC org in the Redwood Console and shares the org ID back (format: org_XXXX).
- Redwood issues scoped API keys (read + generate) for the evaluation service account. Keys will be in the console and rotated after the POC if you want.
- Target: org ID + initial API key delivered by Thu 2026-11-19 EOD.

Workstream B — Network allowlist & egress (owner: Novagen / Sourabh)
- Novagen to provide the allowlist CSV (template attached) containing public egress IPs for the evaluation runners.
- Redwood will provision a temporary peered endpoint and add those IPs to the temporary allowlist on our side.
- Target: allowlist delivered Fri 2026-11-20 12:00 PT; Redwood to confirm ingress by 17:00 PT same day.

Workstream C — VPC peering and route validation (owner: Redwood / Marcus)
- If Novagen prefers VPC peering instead of IP allowlist we can initiate a peering request (proposal below).
- Redwood provides peering block (10.40.0.0/20) and a short peering template; Novagen needs to confirm desired CIDR and route table entries.
- Target: decision by Fri 2026-11-20; if yes, peering handshake to start Mon 2026-11-23 with a 48–72 hour SLA to be ready for evaluation traffic.

Deliverables and acceptance criteria
- API keys that successfully generate a test LLM call (sample curl provided).
- A simple health-check run from Novagen's staging runner that returns 200 and token-latency <500ms (typical).
- A signed mutual acceptance note in the HubSpot activity (I can create the entry).

Next steps (action items):
- Alex: reply with the org ID or a quick OK on the timeline — if you want us to create the org for you, say so and we’ll provision and invite an admin.
- Sourabh: upload allowlist CSV to the Drive link and cc me; I’ll mark items as received.
- Laura: I’ll coordinate the peering template and watch the support ticket for any infra questions.

Attachments: redwood-network-requirements-v1.pdf, novagen-ip-allowlist-template.csv

---
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

---

> Subject: Re: Staged evaluation: access commitments & connectivity compact
>
> Thanks Marcus — this is helpful and the timelines look fine. A couple of clarifications:
> 1) We’ll create the org ourselves and share the org ID by end of day tomorrow.
> 2) For the allowlist, we can do a short-term IP allowlist for the first 48 hours while we evaluate the peering option. That should be enough to run our initial test harness.
> 3) For the API keys — can you scope them to a single model family and restrict to the evaluation org? We prefer that for audit reasons.
>
> I’ll upload the allowlist CSV later today and put Sourabh on the thread for the org ID.
>
> — Alex

Marcus / Alex — uploading the allowlist now (Drive link in the folder). Note our CI runners sit behind a NAT that uses three egress IPs: 34.22.11.143, 34.22.11.144, 34.22.11.145. I put those into the attached CSV.

I also want to confirm: is Redwood OK with a scoped API key limited to model-family: "redwood-alpha" and a daily quota of 10K tokens for the POC?

Sourabh
Lead SRE, Novagen

Sourabh — we received the CSV and have scheduled the allowlist update for 2026-11-20 16:00 PT. Marcus, I’ve opened ticket #INF-2947 to track the peering template and authorization form.

Marcus: quick ask — can you confirm the peering CIDR we’ll propose? I’ve got 10.40.0.0/20 ready but want your sign-off before we send the template to Novagen.

Laura
